evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

step_1_identify_the_only_mechanism_that_.black_cleaver: Carve = '6% armor reduction' per stack, up to 30% at 5 stacks (data/items.json 3071). Armor reduction enters only the mitigation multiplier m(R) = 100/(100+R) (docs/math-foundations.md Sec 2.1). Under the round-trip identity 'post = raw . m(R)', armor reduction is mathematically incapable of changing a raw (pre-mitigation) leaf. Excluded.
step_1_identify_the_only_mechanism_that_.bloodsong: Spellblade passive inflicts 'Expose Weakness' for 4 seconds, 'causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources'. A damage-taken amplifier is a multiplier on the damage instance itself (pre-mitigation), i.e. it lives in raw. This is the ONLY multiplicative amplifier in the scenario's named items, and the only mechanism that can move this leaf.

step_2_resolve_the_wiki_rd_template.claim: {{rd|A|B}} = A for a MELEE item holder, B for a RANGED holder.
proof_from_the_same_cache: Hullbreaker: '{{rd|120%|{{ap|120*0.7}}%}} base AD' - the second argument is literally written as 0.7x the first, i.e. the ranged penalty.
Iceborn Gauntlet: 'slowed by {{rd|25%|{{ap|25*0.5}}%}}' - second argument literally 0.5x the first.
Ravenous Hydra / Tiamat / Stridebreaker: '{{rd|40% AD|20% AD}}' cleave - the well-known 50% ranged cleave penalty.
step_2_resolve_the_wiki_rd_template.conclusion: Bloodsong Expose Weakness = +8% damage taken (melee holder) / +5% (ranged holder).

candidates_tested.1.00 (no amplifier): rejected: it is the old value, and the wiki text says the target takes increased damage 'from all sources'
candidates_tested.1.30 / 1.06 / other item multipliers: no other multiplicative damage-taken amplifier exists in the two named items

step_3_multiplier_test_against_the_golde.implied_unamplified_base: B = old value unrounded. Consistency requires B in [94.05,94.15) AND 1.08.B in [101.65,101.75) => B in [94.12, 94.15). Non-empty: the two displayed numbers are exactly consistent with 'same base, x1.08'.
step_3_multiplier_test_against_the_golde.worked_example_at_the_midpoint: B = 94.135 -> 94.135 x 1.08 = 101.6658 -> displays 101.7, and B itself displays 94.1. Both endpoints reproduced.
step_3_multiplier_test_against_the_golde.additive_cross_check: delta = 7.6 = 8% of 95.0-ish; 0.08 x 94.135 = 7.53, which rounds into the observed 7.6 gap given both endpoints are independently rounded. No plausible additive constant (flat proc, lethality term) matches 7.6 in either item's cached text.

step_4_placement_of_the_amplifier_in_the.rule: docs/math-foundations.md Sec 2.1 fixes the pipeline as post = raw . m(R), with m(R) = 100/(100+R) carrying ALL resistance/penetration/reduction effects.
step_4_placement_of_the_amplifier_in_the.consequence: A 'takes X% increased damage from all sources' debuff is not a resistance term, so it cannot live in m(R); it must scale the damage instance, i.e. raw. Booking Expose Weakness inside raw_damage is therefore the structurally correct placement, and it is also the game's order (amplification before mitigation).
step_4_placement_of_the_amplifier_in_the.roster_semantics: 'from all sources' means the debuff amplifies damage dealt by every attacker on the roster, not only the Bloodsong holder. In a coupled roster scenario this is exactly what makes a non-Bloodsong participant's damage event (the Black Cleaver carrier's) move by 8%.

independent_computation.result: Correct value = (unamplified base) x 1.08 = 101.7. The old 94.1 is the unamplified base, i.e. Expose Weakness was not being credited to this event at all.

assumptions_and_residual_boundaries: MELEE HOLDER ASSUMPTION: 8% is the melee arm of {{rd|8%|5%}}. The scenario roster is defined outside the permitted evidence tree (src/ and tests/ were not read), so the Bloodsong holder's attack type could not be confirmed from data/. If that holder is a RANGED champion, the sourced amplifier is 5% and the correct leaf would be ~98.8, making both 94.1 and 101.7 wrong. The x1.08 fit is exact to the display rounding, and no 1.05 reading fits, so the engine is at minimum self-consistent with the melee arm.

SELF-APPLICATION BOUNDARY: the wiki text says the debuff is inflicted BY the empowered attack ('cooldown ... starts after using the empowered attack'). If events[37] were itself the Expose-Weakness-applying spellblade attack, the amplifier should not scale that same instance. Index 37 is deep in the ledger, consistent with a later event inside the 4 s window, so this boundary is noted rather than charged.

The old value 94.1 is only explicable as the unamplified base: it is exactly (new / 1.08) to within the golden file's 0.1 rounding, and no sourced mechanic in either named item produces a 94.1 that is itself an amplified figure.
verdict_rationale: The wiki text for the scenario's own named item states an unconditional team-wide damage-taken amplifier; the observed change is exactly that amplifier's melee value (x1.08, the unique multiplier admitted by the two rounded endpoints); and the amplifier's correct home is the pre-mitigation raw term under the engine's own post = raw . m(R) identity. The old value credited no amplifier at all and is wrong.
